tool_calls:
umask 077; cd /tmp/collab-r2/reqs3-76d4057b || exit 1; d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ironclaude-batch.XXXXXXXX) || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d" || echo "CLEANUP_FAIL path=$d"' EXIT INT TERM; cat > "$d/batch.sh" <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
set -u -o pipefail
failures=0
echo "BEGIN 1"; out=$(timeout 5 ls 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 1"; else echo "FAIL 1 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 2"; out=$(timeout 5 ls tests 2>&1 | head -5); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 2"; else echo "FAIL 2 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 3"; out=$(timeout 5 git log --oneline -1 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 3"; else echo "FAIL 3 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 4"; out=$(timeout 5 ls docs 2>&1 | head -5); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 4"; else echo "FAIL 4 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 5"; out=$(timeout 5 wc -l README.md 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 5"; else echo "FAIL 5 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 6"; out=$(timeout 5 ls src 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 6"; else echo "FAIL 6 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 7"; out=$(timeout 5 git status --short 2>&1 | head -3); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 7"; else echo "FAIL 7 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 8"; out=$(timeout 5 ls .claude 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 8"; else echo "FAIL 8 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 9"; out=$(timeout 5 head -3 README.md 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 9"; else echo "FAIL 9 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
echo "BEGIN 10"; out=$(timeout 5 ls tests 2>&1 | wc -l); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK 10"; else echo "FAIL 10 rc=$rc"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
if [ "$failures" -eq 0 ]; then echo "BATCH_OK failures=0"; exit 0; else echo "BATCH_FAIL failures=$failures"; exit 1; fi
EOS
bash "$d/batch.sh"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; trap - EXIT INT TERM; exit $rc
